events.title: UK AI chip startup OLIX raises €270.5 million at €2.8 billion valuation just two years after its founding

events.summary:
OLIX, a London-based AI chip startup building the infrastructure for frontier AI inference, today announced a €270.5 million ($312 million) Series B financing round at a €2.8 billion ($3.3 billion) valuation, two years after it was founded. The round included Fundomo, Arm and Hudson River Trading, alongside angel investors including Reed Hastings, the co-founder of […]
The post UK AI chip startup OLIX raises €270.5 million at €2.8 billion valuation just two years after its founding appeared first on EU-Startups.

events.title: Helsinki-based Aiforia secures €20 million EIB financing to advance AI-powered cancer diagnostics

events.summary:
Aiforia, a Helsinki-based life-science company providing deep learning AI solutions for pathology, has secured €20 million in venture debt financing from the European Investment Bank (EIB).  Supported under the European Commission’s InvestEU programme, the financing will accelerate Aiforia’s product development and boost its commercial operations. The financing is divided into three tranches, with a first […]
The post Helsinki-based Aiforia secures €20 million EIB financing to advance AI-powered cancer diagnostics appeared first on EU-Startups.
